659	else
660	    assert_pass "[#1805/DSFSTG-3] setup s10: state branch populated (all-complete interrupted run)"
661	fi
662	
663	# Remove from disk — the artifact lives only on the state branch.
664	rm -f "$S10_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"
665	
666	# State: intake=complete (before <s>), cyc=pending (<s>, the interrupted stage),
667	# verify=complete (after <s>). status=in_progress; --resume flag passed explicitly.
668	jq -n \
669	    --arg run_id "s10-combined-resume-1805" \
670	    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
671	    --argjson issue "$S10_ID" \
672	    '{
673	        schema_version: 1,
674	        run_id: $run_id,
675	        issue: $issue,
676	        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", cyc: "pending", verify: "complete"},
677	        current_iteration: 0,
678	        self_heal_count: {},
679	        scope_manifest_hash: "",
680	        cost_ledger_pointer: 0,
681	        claim_lease_id: "",
682	        plugin_state: {},
683	        status: "in_progress",
684	        updated_at: $now
685	    }' > "$S10_STATE_FILE"
686	
687	# When — the runner is invoked with --resume --from-stage cyc.
688	# This exercises the combined path where skip_until_stage="cyc" is set,
689	# cleared when cyc is reached, and resume_mode must be cleared too (Gap 11 fix)
690	# so the skip guard does not suppress verify despite verify=complete in state.
691	set +e
692	( cd "$S10_WORK_REPO" && env \
693	    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=1 \
694	    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$S3_PLUGINS_ROOT" \
695	    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S10_STATE_DIR" \
696	    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$S10_STATE_FILE" \
697	    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S10_EVENTS_DIR" \
698	    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S10_EVENTS_JSONL" \
699	    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
700	    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
701	    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
702	    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
703	    bash "$RUNNER" --template from-stage-combined-resume \
704	        --resume --from-stage cyc --issue "$S10_ID" ) \
705	    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s10-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s10-stderr.txt"
706	_s10_rc=$?
707	set -e
708	
709	# Then — cycle.start for cyc is emitted (cyc was dispatched as the --from-stage target).
710	# Before the change: on old code, --from-stage may not exist or the cycle dispatch
711	#   path may be incomplete → cycle.start absent → assertion FAILS.
712	# After the change: skip_until_stage cleared at cyc → cyc dispatched → cycle.start → PASSES.
713	_s10_cyc_starts=0
714	if [[ -f "$S10_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
715	    _s10_cyc_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="cycle.start" and .data.cycle_id=="cyc") | .type' \
716	        "$S10_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
717	fi
718	assert_gt "[#1805/DSFSTG-3] cycle.start emitted for cyc (--from-stage target dispatched in combined --resume --from-stage mode)" \
719	    "$_s10_cyc_starts" "0"
720	
721	# Then — stage.start for verify is emitted despite verify=complete in interrupted run state.
722	# This is the Gap 11 assertion: on old code, skip_until_stage is cleared at cyc but
723	# resume_mode remains true, so the resume skip guard fires for verify (complete) and
724	# verify is SKIPPED → no stage.start → assertion FAILS on old code.
725	# After the Gap 11 fix: resume_mode is set to false when skip_until_stage is cleared
726	# at cyc → skip guard does not fire → verify dispatched → stage.start → PASSES.
727	_s10_verify_starts=0
728	if [[ -f "$S10_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
729	    _s10_verify_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start" and .data.stage=="verify") | .type' \
730	        "$S10_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
731	fi
732	assert_gt "[#1805/DSFSTG-3] stage.start emitted for verify despite verify=complete in interrupted state (Gap 11 fix: resume_mode=false clears skip guard after --from-stage target reached; fails on old code where verify is skipped)" \
733	    "$_s10_verify_starts" "0"
734	
735	# Then — no stage.skip event emitted for verify (verify is dispatched, not skipped).
736	# Before the change: verify is skipped → stage.skip might be emitted → verify_skips > 0.
737	# After the change: resume_mode=false → no skip guard → no stage.skip for verify → PASSES.
738	_s10_verify_skips=0
739	if [[ -f "$S10_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
740	    _s10_verify_skips="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.skip" and .data.stage=="verify") | .type' \
741	        "$S10_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
742	fi
743	assert_eq "[#1805/DSFSTG-3] no stage.skip emitted for verify (stage after --from-stage target must be dispatched, not skipped, in combined --resume --from-stage mode)" \
744	    "0" "$_s10_verify_skips"
745	
746	# ── SPEC-4: --from-stage without --resume refuses with diagnostic ─────────────
747	# [#1805/DSFSTG-4]: --from-stage <s> without explicit --resume exits 1 with the
748	#   diagnostic "--from-stage is only valid with --resume", even when auto-resume
749	#   conditions are present (status=interrupted). The guard fires before auto-resume
750	#   processes state, so no pipeline.resume event is emitted.
751	print_test_section "[#1805/DSFSTG-4] --from-stage without --resume refuses before auto-resume"
752	
753	# Given — a state file exists with status=interrupted (auto-resume conditions met);
754	#   --from-stage is specified on the command line; --resume is NOT given.
755	S11_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
756	S11_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s11-state"
757	S11_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s11-events"
758	S11_EVENTS_JSONL="$S11_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
759	S11_STATE_FILE="$S11_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
760	mkdir -p "$S11_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S11_EVENTS_DIR"
761	
762	# State with status=interrupted so auto-resume would otherwise kick in.
763	jq -n \
764	    --arg run_id "s11-fs4-1805" \
765	    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
766	    --argjson issue "$S11_ID" \
767	    '{
768	        schema_version: 1,
769	        run_id: $run_id,
770	        issue: $issue,
771	        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", cyc: "pending"},
772	        current_iteration: 0,
773	        self_heal_count: {},
774	        scope_manifest_hash: "",
775	        cost_ledger_pointer: 0,
776	        claim_lease_id: "",
777	        plugin_state: {},
778	        status: "interrupted",
779	        updated_at: $now
780	    }' > "$S11_STATE_FILE"
781	
782	# Reuse S3_WORK_REPO (artifact-snapshot-coverage template, which has the cyc
783	# stage). S3_PLUGINS_ROOT is also reused (intake, build, cycled mocks present).
784	
785	# When — the runner is invoked with --from-stage but no --resume.
786	set +e
787	( cd "$S3_WORK_REPO" && env \
788	    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=1 \
789	    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$S3_PLUGINS_ROOT" \
790	    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S11_STATE_DIR" \
791	    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$S11_STATE_FILE" \
792	    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S11_EVENTS_DIR" \
793	    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S11_EVENTS_JSONL" \
794	    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
795	    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
796	    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
797	    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
798	    bash "$RUNNER" --template artifact-snapshot-coverage \
799	        --from-stage cyc --issue "$S11_ID" ) \
800	    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s11-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s11-stderr.txt"
801	_s11_rc=$?
802	set -e
803	
804	# Then — the runner exits 1.
805	# Before change: guard absent → runner auto-resumes (exits 0) or fails for a
806	#   different reason → exit code != 1 → assertion FAILS.
807	# After change: guard fires → runner exits 1 → PASSES.
808	assert_eq "[#1805/DSFSTG-4] --from-stage without --resume exits 1" \
809	    "1" "$_s11_rc"
810	
811	# Then — stderr contains the diagnostic "--from-stage is only valid with --resume".
812	# Before change: guard absent → diagnostic not emitted → FAILS.
813	# After change: guard emits diagnostic → PASSES.
814	_s11_stderr="$(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s11-stderr.txt" 2>/dev/null || true)"
815	assert_contains \
816	    "[#1805/DSFSTG-4] stderr contains --from-stage is only valid with --resume" \
817	    "$_s11_stderr" "--from-stage is only valid with --resume"
818	
819	# Then — no pipeline.resume event is emitted (guard fires before auto-resume processes
820	#   state, so auto-resume never runs).
821	# Before change: auto-resume runs → pipeline.resume emitted → count > 0 → FAILS.
822	# After change: guard fires before auto-resume → no pipeline.resume → PASSES.
823	_s11_resume_events=0
824	if [[ -f "$S11_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
825	    _s11_resume_events="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="pipeline.resume") | .type' \
826	        "$S11_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
827	fi
828	assert_eq "[#1805/DSFSTG-4] no pipeline.resume event emitted (guard fires before auto-resume)" \
829	    "0" "$_s11_resume_events"
830	
831	cleanup_test_env
832	print_test_results
833	exit $((FAIL > 0))

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# tests/unit/status-row-findings-test.sh — a row for a try that did not pass
3	# says what failed (ADR-064 §4, amended 2026-11-06, #2476).
4	#
5	# Why: on #1805 run 42127743259 a failing design try's row read "the design fails
6	# 2 check(s)" and, folded, "The findings are in design's result. This try is
7	# kept as the working copy…"; test-author's read "8 finding(s) about its
8	# assertions are open — the next try fixes them". Nothing said what failed:
9	# since #2470 the findings live in the stage's result only, and the row was
10	# built from the summary only. The row is for the person reading the issue.
11	#
12	# W1 [change] a try that did not pass, whose result holds findings: the row's
13	#             line says how many (#2480: not the first finding, which the folded
14	#             list repeated); the folded part lists every finding once; nothing
15	#             of the summary is shown
16	# W2 [change] a map member (a lens) reads its own result, named on its event,
17	#             and a lens's finding is its message and file
18	# W3 [guard]  a try that did not pass and has no findings shows its summary
19	# W4 [guard]  a try that passed shows its summary, whatever its result holds
20	# W5 [change] #2480: findings with a severity are counted by it
21	# W6 [change] #2480: one finding of several lines: its first line heads the row,
22	#             the rest is folded, and the first line is not said twice
23	# W8 [change] several findings without a severity: the row's line names the
24	#             requirement or SPEC each is about, as the run's rows did not
25	#             ("what failed: 2 findings", #1805 run 42293991602)
26	# W7 [change] #2480: a try run again because its result held findings shows
27	#             as failed, not `unusable` (test-author's own label for "my check
28	#             found something", #2460); one with no findings stays unusable
29	set -uo pipefail

31	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
32	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
33	# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/helpers.sh
34	source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/helpers.sh"

54	# The stage's own writers make its files (#1799): the result with its findings,

91	stage_summary_write "$A/fine-summary.md" fine pass "wrote tests for LOOP-1 and KEEP-1"

94	if grep -qF "what failed" <<< "$w4"; then assert_fail "[W4] …and never says what failed" "$w4"
95	else assert_pass "[W4] …and never says what failed"; fi

97	# ── W8 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
98	# The words of #1805 run 42293991602's issue-acceptance and test findings.
99	stage_result_write "$A/issue-acceptance-result.json" fail "2 requirements not met" "{\"findings\":$(printf '%s\n' \
100	        'The issue requires this and the change does not meet it: LOOP-1: `_cycle_iter_dispatch` has no code to skip cycle members already marked complete' \
101	        'The issue requires this and the change does not meet it: GUAR-2: The FRSH-2 third assertion added in this DIFF asserts `_frsh2_cycled_starts==1`' | stage_findings_json)}"
102	w8="$(rsc_render_row "$S" "$(_row 3.1.1.1.5 issue-acceptance fail)")"

104	stage_result_write "$A/test-result.json" fail "2 files fail" "{\"findings\":$(printf '%s\n' \

107	w8t="$(rsc_render_row "$S" "$(_row 3.1.1.1.4 test fail)")"

109	stage_result_write "$A/note-result.json" fail "2 problems" "{\"findings\":$(printf '%s\n' 'the build left a temp file' 'the build log is empty' | stage_findings_json)}"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# scripts/lib/run-status-text.sh — what a row of the run-status comment says
3	# (#2131, ADR-064 §4): a stage's findings and its summary's first line, as
4	# text. Sourced by run-status-render.sh; split from it (#2480) to keep each
5	# under 500 lines. Pure: reads files, writes nothing.
6	
7	[[ -n "${_ZBUILD_RUN_STATUS_TEXT_LOADED:-}" ]] && return 0 2>/dev/null
8	_ZBUILD_RUN_STATUS_TEXT_LOADED=1
9	
10	# rsc_row_findings_v <var> <state_dir> <stage> [result_path] — what a try that
11	# did not pass found (ADR-064 §4, #2476, #2480): "what failed: <the finding>",
12	# or the requirements and SPECs several are about ("what failed: `LOOP-1`,
13	# `GUAR-2`"), else "what failed: <n> findings", and what more there is folded
14	# under it; empty
15	# when its result holds none. The
16	# result is the stage's primary output (a map member's is named on its event),
17	# else `artifacts/<stage>-result.json`. A finding is its text, as
18	# stage_findings_json writes it, or a lens's severity, message and file.
19	rsc_row_findings_v() {
20	    local _rfv_p="${4:-}" _rfv_m="" _rfv_raw="" _rfv_l
21	    printf -v "$1" '%s' ""
22	    if [[ -z "$_rfv_p" ]] && declare -F _inputs_stage_manifest_v >/dev/null 2>&1 \
23	            && declare -F _verdict_primary_output_path_v >/dev/null 2>&1; then
24	        _inputs_stage_manifest_v _rfv_m "$3" "${ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT:-$_RSC_ROOT/plugins}" 2>/dev/null || true
25	        [[ -n "$_rfv_m" && -f "$_rfv_m" ]] && _verdict_primary_output_path_v _rfv_raw "$_rfv_m"
26	        [[ -n "$_rfv_raw" ]] && _rfv_p="$(_inputs_output_paths "$3" "$_rfv_raw" "$2" 2>/dev/null || true)"
27	    fi
28	    [[ -n "$_rfv_p" && -s "$_rfv_p" ]] || _rfv_p="$2/artifacts/${3}-result.json"
29	    [[ -s "$_rfv_p" && "$(<"$_rfv_p")" == *'"findings"'* ]] || return 0
30	    # #2480: one finding heads the row, the rest of its lines folded; several
31	    # are named by the id each is about, or counted (by severity when they
32	    # carry one), and each is listed once.
33	    _rfv_l="$(jq -r "$_RSC_JQ_ESC"'[ ((.data.findings // .findings // [])[]? | select(type == "object")
34	            | {sev: (if (.severity | type) == "string" then (.severity | ascii_downcase) else null end),
35	               t: (if (.text | type) == "string" then .text
36	                   elif (.message | type) == "string" then
37	                       (if (.severity | type) == "string" then "\(.severity): " else "" end) + .message
38	                       + (if (.file // "unknown") != "unknown" then " (\(.file)\(if .line then ":\(.line)" else "" end))" else "" end)
39	                   else null end)}
40	            | select(.t != null) | .t |= (gsub("\r"; "") | gsub("\n+$"; "") | esc) | select(.t | test("[^[:space:]]"))) ] as $f
41	        | if ($f | length) == 0 then ""
42	          elif ($f | length) == 1 then
43	            ($f[0].t | split("\n")) as $ls
44	            | "what failed: " + ($ls[0] | gsub("\\|"; "\\|"))
45	              + (if ($ls | length) > 1 then
46	                  "\n<details><summary>what failed</summary>\n\n- " + ($ls[1:] | join("\n  ")) + "\n\n</details>"
47	                else "" end)
48	          else
49	            ([$f[] | .sev | select(. != null)]) as $sv
50	            | (["critical", "high", "medium", "low"]
51	               | map(. as $k | ([$sv[] | select(. == $k)] | length) as $c | select($c > 0) | "\($c) \($k)")) as $cnt
52	            # The requirement or SPEC each is about: the first id on its first
53	            # line. Named when every finding has one and none has a severity.
54	            | [$f[] | .t | split("\n")[0]
55	               | [match("(?<![A-Za-z0-9-])[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{2,5}-[0-9]+(?![0-9])"; "g").string][0]] as $ids
56	            | (if ($sv | length) == 0 and all($ids[]; . != null)
57	               then "what failed: " + ($ids | reduce .[] as $i ([]; if index([$i]) then . else . + [$i] end)
58	                                           | map("`" + . + "`") | join(", "))
59	               else "what failed: \($f | length) findings" + (if ($cnt | length) > 0 then ": " + ($cnt | join(", ")) else "" end) end)
60	              + "\n<details><summary>what failed</summary>\n\n"
61	              + ([$f[] | "- " + (.t | gsub("\n"; "\n  "))] | join("\n")) + "\n\n</details>"
62	          end' "$_rfv_p" 2>/dev/null || true)"
63	    [[ -n "$_rfv_l" ]] || return 0
64	    _rsc_code_labels_v _rfv_l "$_rfv_l"
65	    printf -v "$1" '%s' "$_rfv_l"
66	}
67	
68	# _rsc_first_line_v <var> <summary_file> — the first line with a non-blank
69	# character that is not a heading, `- ` stripped, `|` escaped, whole; the rest
70	# folded under it.
71	_rsc_first_line_v() {
72	    local _rsv_p="$2" _rsv_l=""
73	    printf -v "$1" '%s' ""
74	    [[ -s "$_rsv_p" ]] || return 0
75	    # The first line with a non-blank character that is not a heading, read by
76	    # the shell (it was an awk: `NF && $0 !~ /^#/`).
77	    local _rsv_found=0 _rsv_rest="" _rsv_x
78	    while IFS= read -r _rsv_x || [[ -n "$_rsv_x" ]]; do
79	        if (( _rsv_found )); then
80	            _rsv_rest+="${_rsv_x}"$'\n'
81	        elif [[ "$_rsv_x" =~ [^[:space:]] && "$_rsv_x" != \#* ]]; then
82	            _rsv_found=1; _rsv_l="$_rsv_x"
83	        fi
84	    done < "$_rsv_p"
85	    (( _rsv_found )) || return 0
86	    _rsv_l="${_rsv_l#- }"
87	    _rsc_text_v _rsv_l "$_rsv_l"
88	    _rsv_l="${_rsv_l//|/\\|}"
89	    # The rest, without its leading and trailing blank lines.
90	    while [[ "$_rsv_rest" == $'\n'* ]]; do _rsv_rest="${_rsv_rest#$'\n'}"; done
91	    while [[ "$_rsv_rest" == *$'\n' ]]; do _rsv_rest="${_rsv_rest%$'\n'}"; done
92	    _rsc_text_v _rsv_rest "$_rsv_rest"
93	    [[ "$_rsv_rest" =~ [^[:space:]] ]] \
94	        && _rsv_l+=$'\n'"<details><summary>the rest of what it reported</summary>"$'\n\n'"${_rsv_rest}"$'\n\n'"</details>"
95	    _rsc_code_labels_v _rsv_l "$_rsv_l"
96	    printf -v "$1" '%s' "$_rsv_l"
97	}
98	
99	# _rsc_text_v <var> <text> — what a stage wrote, as text (#2480, ADR-064 §4):
100	# `<` and `>` outside a code span become < and >, so GitHub never takes
101	# `<s>` for a tag; inside one they stay. Read by the shell, appended piece by
102	# piece: a pattern replacement's `&` means the match in bash 5.2.
103	_rsc_text_v() {
104	    local -n _rtv="$1"; local _rt_in="$2" _rt_out="" _rt_seg _rt_code=0
105	    while [[ "$_rt_in" == *'`'* ]]; do
106	        _rt_seg="${_rt_in%%\`*}"; _rt_in="${_rt_in#*\`}"
107	        if (( _rt_code )); then _rt_out+="$_rt_seg"; else _rsc_text_plain "$_rt_seg"; fi
108	        _rt_out+='`'; _rt_code=$(( 1 - _rt_code ))
109	    done
110	    # A backtick with no partner opens no span (review on #2481): what follows
111	    # it is text.
112	    _rsc_text_plain "$_rt_in"
113	    _rtv="$_rt_out"
114	}
115	# _rsc_text_plain <text> — <text> outside a code span, escaped, appended to
116	# _rt_out, the local of its caller _rsc_text_v (bash's dynamic scope).
117	_rsc_text_plain() {
118	    local _rtp="$1"
119	    while [[ "$_rtp" == *[\<\>]* ]]; do
120	        _rt_out+="${_rtp%%[\<\>]*}"; _rtp="${_rtp#"${_rtp%%[\<\>]*}"}"
121	        if [[ "$_rtp" == \<* ]]; then _rt_out+='<'; else _rt_out+='>'; fi
122	        _rtp="${_rtp:1}"
123	    done
124	    _rt_out+="$_rtp"
125	}
126	
127	# _rsc_code_labels_v <var> <text> — each requirement label, `[#1805/FSTG-1]`
128	# (#2462: any SPEC id, descriptive or the old SPEC-3; #2482: with its prefix),
129	# shown as code (#2460): GitHub links `#1805` and shows the issue's title in its
130	# place. One already between backticks is left as it is. Read by the shell.
131	_rsc_code_labels_v() {
132	    local -n _rcl="$1"; local _in="$2" _out="" _pre _lbl
133	    local _re='\[#[0-9]+/[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{2,5}-[0-9]+\]'
134	    while [[ "$_in" =~ $_re ]]; do
135	        _lbl="${BASH_REMATCH[0]}"; _pre="${_in%%"$_lbl"*}"
136	        if [[ "$_pre" == *'`' ]]; then _out+="$_pre$_lbl"; else _out+="$_pre\`$_lbl\`"; fi
137	        _in="${_in#*"$_lbl"}"
138	    done
139	    # Append an empty code span after the last label so the label's closing
140	    # backtick is not misread as opening a new span by some renderers.
141	    if [[ -n "$_out" ]]; then _rcl="$_out${_in}\`\`"; else _rcl="$_in"; fi
142	}

Here are the full contents of all five files:

---

## 1. `plugins/tool/hydrate/plugin.sh` (199 lines)

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# plugins/tool/hydrate/plugin.sh — Hydrate stage (#1074, ADR-050 §7, ADR-059 §3)
#
# Kind: tool  Tier: T0  (NO LLM calls — NEVER call route_to_model)
#
# Puts this issue's earlier outputs, saved on `zbuild/state/issue-<N>`, back in
# their LIVE places in the run's artifacts folder. First stage in the flow,
# before intake. A rerun of an issue continues it (ADR-050, amended; ADR-068
# §8): an earlier run's output is that stage's latest output until the stage
# writes a newer one, so there is one place to read and no "restored" area.
# A file the run already has live is newer and is kept.
#
# A PARTIAL TREE IS NEVER PUT BACK. `git archive | tar` can fail mid-stream
# (disk full, permissions) leaving a half-extracted tree. PR #1880's review
# caught the engine adopting one. Extraction goes to a staging dir and only a
# complete one is copied into place.
...
```

Full content returned above. Key points:
- `hydrate_run` checks `ZBUILD_RESUME` (line 100): if `0`, fetches and adopts remote but skips restore, writing a "fresh start" pass result.
- On normal resume: fetches, restores to staging, validates completeness, then calls `_artifact_persist_put_back` to merge into live artifacts (no-clobber).
- Always returns 0 — prior work is advisory, not fatal.
- `_hydrate_put_back` is a thin delegate to `_artifact_persist_put_back` (line 63–65).

---

## 2. `core/state/artifact-persist.sh` (652 lines)

Full content returned above. Key points:
- Outcome channel: three globals (`_ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_STATUS`, `_ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_SOURCE`, `_ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_REASON`) reset at the top of every public entry point.
- `_artifact_persist_put_back` (lines 638–651): copies files from `<from>` to `<to>`, skipping `stage-io/` entries and existing files (no-clobber), with path-traversal guards (`../*`, `/*`).
- `_artifact_persist_snapshot`: builds a throwaway git index, writes a tree, commits onto `zbuild/state/issue-<N>` without touching the working tree or real index. Batch-stages via `hash-object --stdin-paths` + `update-index --index-info` (#2249), falls back per-file on batch failure.
- `_artifact_persist_restore`: prefers `refs/heads/<branch>`, falls back to `refs/remotes/origin/<branch>`; uses `git archive | tar` with PIPESTATUS check; sets `_ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_SOURCE` to `"local"` or `"remote"`.
- `_artifact_persist_adopt_remote`: absent-only — only sets `refs/heads/<branch>` to the remote tip when the local ref does not exist.
- `_artifact_persist_push`: force-pushes to origin; best-effort, sets status/reason on failure.

---

## 3. `tests/integration/pipeline-resume-test.sh` (344 lines)

Full content returned above. Key points:
- Tests `get_resume_recommendation` for states: `in_progress < 24h` → `auto_resume`; `complete` → `fresh_start`; `aborted` → `manual_resume_only`; no file → `fresh_start`; `in_progress > 24h` → `manual_resume_only`; `interrupted` → `auto_resume`.
- Integration test: runs `runner.sh --resume` with `intake=complete, build=pending` state; asserts `build` completes, `intake` is skipped (1 `stage.start` event), and a `pipeline.resume` event is emitted.
- Tests `--from-stage` with unknown stage exits 1 with "is not a known stage" message.
- Tests `--from-stage` without `--resume` exits 1 with "only valid with --resume" message (uses `status:"complete"` state to avoid auto-resume triggering instead).
- Pre-writes `intake-result.json` artifact (line 254–255) to satisfy the SPEC-2 stale-artifact check added in #1805.

---

## 4. `tests/fixtures/templates/from-stage-combined-resume.yaml` (32 lines)

```yaml
id: from-stage-combined-resume
name: Combined --resume --from-stage test fixture (#1805)
extends: simple
defaults:
  strategy: fanout

stages:
  - id: intake
    gate: auto
    roles: [intake]
  - id: cyc
    type: cycle
    stages: [cycled]
    until:
      stage: cycled
      field: verdict
      op: eq
      value: pass
    max_iterations: 1
    on_max: continue
  - id: verify
    gate: auto

stage_definitions:
  cycled:
    roles: [builder]
```

Three-stage fixture for DSFSTG-3: `intake` (leaf before target) → `cyc` (cycle, the `--from-stage` target) → `verify` (leaf after target). Tests that stages after the `--from-stage` target are still dispatched after the `skip_until_stage` guard clears.

---

## 5. `scripts/lib/run-status-text.sh` (143 lines)

Full content returned above. Key points:

1591	# ─── _runner_enter_worktree <state_dir> <run_id> [wt_key] ────────────────────
1592	# ADR-052 (#1640): put the runner in the run's own worktree BEFORE the first
1593	# stage dispatches, so every stage inherits it and no stage has to know it exists.
1594	#
1595	# The predecessor design (#888) had intake create the worktree and cd into it.
1596	# intake's cd and export die with its dispatch subshell, so every LATER stage fell
1597	# back to `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` from the runner's untouched CWD — the
1598	# main checkout, on whatever branch it held. build then committed there. Nothing
1599	# refused, nothing warned; `pr_open` caught it at the very end of the run, or on a
1600	# run that died earlier, nothing caught it at all (#1640: 3h49m of work lost in CI,
1601	# and a stray commit on `main` locally).
1602	#
1603	# So the fix is not to notice intake's worktree after the fact — that keeps the
1604	# engine coupled to one plugin's artifact and keeps a window where stages run in
1605	# the wrong tree. The worktree is run infrastructure, acquired from run_id alone,
1606	# exactly like state_dir. Being branch-free is what lets the engine own it: intake
1607	# still decides the branch, and checks it out here.
1608	#
1609	# Ordering: called AFTER the engine's own bookkeeping (state, events, artifact
1610	# restore, self-host snapshot — all of which belong in the main checkout) and
1611	# BEFORE any stage dispatch.
1612	#
1613	# Fail-CLOSED throughout (ADR-001). A recorded worktree that has vanished, or an
1614	# acquire that fails, both abort: continuing in the main checkout is precisely the
1615	# damage this exists to prevent, and it is silent damage.
1616	_runner_enter_worktree() {
1617	    local state_dir="${1:-}" run_id="${2:-}" wt_key="${3:-}"
1618	    # #141 (ADR-059 §2): the tree is keyed by the ISSUE, not the run, so every
1619	    # run of an issue lands in the same tree and the #1658/#1869 branch
1620	    # collision cannot arise. Falls back to run_id for a run with no identity,
1621	    # which is the only case that still needs a per-run tree.
1622	    [[ -n "$wt_key" ]] || wt_key="$run_id"
1623	
1624	    # The main checkout stays addressable after the re-root. intake's dirty-tree
1625	    # preflight targets it deliberately (a freshly-acquired worktree is always
1626	    # clean, so preflighting THAT would be a vacuous check that silently made
1627	    # worktree mode more permissive than the in-place path).
1628	    #
1629	    # An inherited ZBUILD_REPO_ROOT is honoured — callers legitimately use it to
1630	    # target a repo other than $PWD (scripts/release.sh, most plugin tests). But a
1631	    # value pointing at a LINKED worktree is a leak from an earlier run in the same
1632	    # process tree, not a target: adopting it would make the preflight read a
1633	    # pipeline-created tree (always clean) instead of the operator's (PR #1643
1634	    # review). A linked worktree's git-dir sits under `.git/worktrees/<name>`,
1635	    # which is portable to detect — unlike --path-format, which needs git >= 2.31.
1636	    if [[ -z "${ZBUILD_MAIN_REPO_ROOT:-}" ]]; then
1637	        local _mrr="${ZBUILD_REPO_ROOT:-}"
1638	        if [[ -n "$_mrr" ]]; then
1639	            local _gd; _gd="$(git -C "$_mrr" rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null || true)"
1640	            [[ "$_gd" == *"/.git/worktrees/"* ]] && _mrr=""
1641	        fi
1642	        [[ -n "$_mrr" ]] || _mrr="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"
1643	        export ZBUILD_MAIN_REPO_ROOT="$_mrr"
1644	    fi
1645	
1646	    # An already-recorded worktree wins over acquiring a new one, and wins even
1647	    # when worktrees are now disabled: a resume of a worktree run must land in the
1648	    # tree its earlier stages worked in, whatever the current env says.
1649	    local rec wt=""
1650	    if rec="$(_runner_worktree_record "$state_dir")"; then
1651	        wt="$(<"$rec")"; wt="${wt%%$'\n'*}"
1652	        if [[ -n "$wt" && ! -d "$wt" ]]; then
1653	            error "the run's worktree is missing: $wt"
1654	            error "  earlier stages worked there; continuing in the main checkout would use the wrong files."
1655	            error "  recreate it, or start a fresh run with --no-resume."
1656	            emit_event "pipeline.worktree.missing" "worktree=$wt" 2>/dev/null || true
1657	            return 1
1658	        fi
1659	    fi
1660	
1661	    if [[ -z "$wt" ]]; then
1662	        declare -F zbuild_worktree_enabled >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
1663	        zbuild_worktree_enabled || return 0
1664	        # Needs a key to derive the path. The runner always supplies one; this
1665	        # guards direct callers only.
1666	        [[ -n "$wt_key" ]] || return 0
1667	        if ! wt="$(zbuild_worktree_acquire "$wt_key" "$ZBUILD_MAIN_REPO_ROOT")"; then
1668	            error "could not acquire the run's worktree (see above)"
1669	            emit_event "pipeline.worktree.acquire_failed" "run_id=$run_id" "wt_key=$wt_key" 2>/dev/null || true
1670	            return 1
1671	        fi
1672	        printf '%s\n' "$wt" > "$state_dir/run-worktree.txt"
1673	    fi
1674	
1675	    cd "$wt" || { error "cannot cd into the run's worktree: $wt"; return 1; }
1676	    export ZBUILD_REPO_ROOT="$wt"
1677	    info "Working in the run's worktree $wt"
1678	    emit_event "pipeline.worktree.entered" "worktree=$wt" "run_id=$run_id" 2>/dev/null || true
1679	    return 0
1680	}

---

## Git diff summary

The diff adds **~370 new lines** across the following logical areas:

**Two new functions added after `_runner_rearm_traps` (lines 1689–1783):**

1. `_runner_resume_rehydrate <issue> <state_dir>` (#1805, ADR-006 §3.6): Restores completed-stage artifacts from the git state branch before the dispatch loop. Non-fatal on failure; a missing artifact causes exit 1 at the stale-artifact check. Uses `_artifact_persist_restore` + `_artifact_persist_put_back` via a staging directory.

2. `_runner_from_stage_preflight <issue> <stages_arr> <from_stage> <state_dir> <plugins_root> [skip_restore]` (#1805, SPEC-3/SPEC-4): For `--from-stage <s>`, optionally restores artifacts, then verifies every stage before `<s>` has its primary artifact. Accepts `skip_restore=true` to avoid redundant git-archive when already restored. Handles cycle IDs as targets (stop at cycle's first member stage). Security: rejects artifact paths outside `artifact_dir`.

**Changes in `main()`:**

- **Issue auto-discovery from ZBUILD_STATE_FILE and `latest` symlink** (DSENTR-2/#1805): reads issue number from state file or latest-symlink state file when no `--issue`/`--goal` given, with TOCTOU-safe symlink escape checks.

- **Moved `--from-stage` without `--resume` rejection** to after the auto-resume block (DSFSTG-1) so a qualifying auto-resume run doesn't need explicit `--resume`.

- **Added `--from-stage` + startup preflight bypass**: temporarily sets `resume_mode=true` before `_runner_startup_preflight_gate` so a spurious persona-missing failure doesn't fire before the "only valid with --resume" rejection.

- **Cycle ID accepted as `--from-stage` target**: validates against `_TPL_CYCLES` in addition to `active_stages`.

- **DSFSTG-4/RQFROM-4 guard** (Gap 12): when `--from-stage` is given without explicit `--resume` and the state file is `status=interrupted`, rejects before auto-resume runs.

- **Auto-resume via latest symlink** (ADR-059 §1/#1805 DSENTR-2): new `elif` arm in the resume policy block; resolves symlink, validates escape, reads recommendation from resolved path, sanitizes run_id/issue.

- **Post-auto-resume `--from-stage` guard** (DSFSTG-1): final check that `--from-stage` requires resume mode.

- **Fresh-start guards** (RQGUAR-1/#1805): exports `_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE=false` and `_ZBUILD_FROM_STAGE_EMIT_START=false` to prevent subprocess runners from inheriting stale values.

- **Resume path**: calls `_runner_resume_rehydrate`, exports `_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE=true`. When `--from-stage` is set, clears `_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE=false` and optionally sets `_ZBUILD_FROM_STAGE_EMIT_START=true` for cycle targets (DSFSTG-1).

- **`_runner_from_stage_preflight` call** before the dispatch loop: passes `resume_mode` as `skip_restore` to avoid double git-archive.

- **Dispatch-unit loop (`cycle:*` arm)**: adds resume skip guard (checks `stage_statuses` for `complete`, verifies member artifacts fail-closed, skips), `--from-stage` skip guard, `skip_until_stage` + `resume_mode` clearance (DSFSTG-3). Also records cycle completion in `stage_statuses` via `_update_stage_status` after convergence (so the resume skip guard can detect it).

- **Dispatch-unit loop (`stage:*` arm)**: adds resume skip guard with artifact fail-closed check (SPEC-2), `--from-stage` skip guard, `skip_until_stage` + `resume_mode` clearance (DSFSTG-3).

- **Linear loop stale-artifact handling changed from warn-and-continue to `return 1`** (SPEC-2/#1805 fail-closed).

- **`cycle_dispatch_stage` backward-compat id fallback**: when role-based resolution fails, falls back to `_find_plugin_for_stage` for id-only mock plugins in test harnesses (#1805).

607	# : the fixture is cyclic (type: cycle present).
608	_s13_fs_content="$(cat "$REPO_ROOT/tests/fixtures/templates/artifact-snapshot-coverage.yaml")"
609	assert_contains "[#1805/DSCYCL-1] from-stage-rehydrate test uses a cyclic fixture (type: cycle)" \
610	    "$_s13_fs_content" "type: cycle"
611	
612	# : confirm the cyclic pipeline ran (intake dispatched in the fresh run).
613	_s13_fs_intake_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start" and .data.stage=="intake") | .type' \
614	    "$_S13_FS_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
615	assert_eq "cyclic fixture pipeline ran in from-stage-rehydrate test (intake dispatched)" \
616	    "1" "$_s13_fs_intake_starts"
617	
618	# ── SPEC-10: combined --resume --from-stage <s>: stages after <s> dispatched despite being marked complete ──
619	print_test_section "[#1805/DSFSTG-3] combined --resume --from-stage <s>: stages after <s> dispatched despite being marked complete in interrupted run"
620	
621	# Given — a previous run was interrupted; stages before cyc (intake=complete) and
622	#   stages after cyc (verify=complete) are both marked complete in persisted state;
623	#   cyc (the target) is pending (the interrupted stage); the runner is invoked with
624	#   --resume --from-stage cyc (auto-resume active).
625	# This sub-case uses the from-stage-combined-resume fixture:
626	#   [intake (leaf), cyc (cycle with cycled), verify (leaf)].
627	
628	S10_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
629	S10_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s10-state"
630	S10_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s10-events"
631	S10_EVENTS_JSONL="$S10_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
632	S10_STATE_FILE="$S10_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
633	mkdir -p "$S10_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S10_EVENTS_DIR"
634	
635	# Fresh git repo; _artifact_persist_snapshot writes the state branch here.
636	S10_WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo fs-rehydrate-s10)"
637	# Protect fixture install: on before-code state from-stage-combined-resume may not
638	# exist. With the guard, the script continues; the runner won't run; events stay
639	# absent; the assert_gt assertions below FAIL naturally for the right reason.
640	_s10_tpl_rc=0
641	install_template_overlay "$S10_WORK_REPO" from-stage-combined-resume 2>/dev/null \
642	    || _s10_tpl_rc=$?
643	
644	# Add mock for verify stage (intake and cycled mocks already in S3_PLUGINS_ROOT).
645	mock_plugin_factory "verify" "agent" 0 >/dev/null
646	
647	# Create intake primary artifact so the --from-stage preflight can restore it.
648	printf '{"result_contract":3,"outcome":"pass","reason":"s10-intake-complete"}' \
649	    > "$S10_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"
650	
651	# Snapshot onto the state branch (places intake artifact on git state branch).
652	_s10_snap_rc=0
653	( export ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S10_STATE_DIR"
654	  cd "$S10_WORK_REPO" && _artifact_persist_snapshot "$S10_STATE_DIR" "$S10_ID" ) \
655	    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s10-snap.log" 2>&1 || _s10_snap_rc=$?
656	if [[ "$_s10_snap_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
657	    assert_fail "[#1805/DSFSTG-3] setup s10: snapshot failed" \
658	        "rc=$_s10_snap_rc; $(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s10-snap.log" 2>/dev/null | tail -5)"
659	else
660	    assert_pass "[#1805/DSFSTG-3] setup s10: state branch populated (all-complete interrupted run)"
661	fi
662	
663	# Remove from disk — the artifact lives only on the state branch.
664	rm -f "$S10_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"
665	
666	# State: intake=complete (before <s>), cyc=pending (<s>, the interrupted stage),
667	# verify=complete (after <s>). status=in_progress; --resume flag passed explicitly.
668	jq -n \
669	    --arg run_id "s10-combined-resume-1805" \
670	    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
671	    --argjson issue "$S10_ID" \
672	    '{
673	        schema_version: 1,
674	        run_id: $run_id,
675	        issue: $issue,
676	        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", cyc: "pending", verify: "complete"},
677	        current_iteration: 0,
678	        self_heal_count: {},
679	        scope_manifest_hash: "",
680	        cost_ledger_pointer: 0,
681	        claim_lease_id: "",
682	        plugin_state: {},
683	        status: "in_progress",
684	        updated_at: $now
685	    }' > "$S10_STATE_FILE"
686	
687	# When — the runner is invoked with --resume --from-stage cyc.
688	# This exercises the combined path where skip_until_stage="cyc" is set,
689	# cleared when cyc is reached, and resume_mode must be cleared too (Gap 11 fix)
690	# so the skip guard does not suppress verify despite verify=complete in state.
691	set +e
692	( cd "$S10_WORK_REPO" && env \
693	    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=1 \
694	    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$S3_PLUGINS_ROOT" \
695	    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S10_STATE_DIR" \
696	    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$S10_STATE_FILE" \
697	    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S10_EVENTS_DIR" \
698	    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S10_EVENTS_JSONL" \
699	    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
700	    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
701	    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
702	    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
703	    bash "$RUNNER" --template from-stage-combined-resume \
704	        --resume --from-stage cyc --issue "$S10_ID" ) \
705	    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s10-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s10-stderr.txt"
706	_s10_rc=$?
707	set -e
708	
709	# Then — cycle.start for cyc is emitted (cyc was dispatched as the --from-stage target).
710	# Before the change: on old code, --from-stage may not exist or the cycle dispatch
711	#   path may be incomplete → cycle.start absent → assertion FAILS.
712	# After the change: skip_until_stage cleared at cyc → cyc dispatched → cycle.start → PASSES.
713	_s10_cyc_starts=0
714	if [[ -f "$S10_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
715	    _s10_cyc_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="cycle.start" and .data.cycle_id=="cyc") | .type' \
716	        "$S10_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
717	fi
718	assert_gt "[#1805/DSFSTG-3] cycle.start emitted for cyc (--from-stage target dispatched in combined --resume --from-stage mode)" \
719	    "$_s10_cyc_starts" "0"
720	
721	# Then — stage.start for verify is emitted despite verify=complete in interrupted run state.
722	# This is the Gap 11 assertion: on old code, skip_until_stage is cleared at cyc but
723	# resume_mode remains true, so the resume skip guard fires for verify (complete) and
724	# verify is SKIPPED → no stage.start → assertion FAILS on old code.
725	# After the Gap 11 fix: resume_mode is set to false when skip_until_stage is cleared
726	# at cyc → skip guard does not fire → verify dispatched → stage.start → PASSES.
727	_s10_verify_starts=0
728	if [[ -f "$S10_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
729	    _s10_verify_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start" and .data.stage=="verify") | .type' \
730	        "$S10_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
731	fi
732	assert_gt "[#1805/DSFSTG-3] stage.start emitted for verify despite verify=complete in interrupted state (Gap 11 fix: resume_mode=false clears skip guard after --from-stage target reached; fails on old code where verify is skipped)" \
733	    "$_s10_verify_starts" "0"
734	
735	# Then — no stage.skip event emitted for verify (verify is dispatched, not skipped).
736	# Before the change: verify is skipped → stage.skip might be emitted → verify_skips > 0.
737	# After the change: resume_mode=false → no skip guard → no stage.skip for verify → PASSES.
738	_s10_verify_skips=0
739	if [[ -f "$S10_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
740	    _s10_verify_skips="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.skip" and .data.stage=="verify") | .type' \
741	        "$S10_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
742	fi
743	assert_eq "[#1805/DSFSTG-3] no stage.skip emitted for verify (stage after --from-stage target must be dispatched, not skipped, in combined --resume --from-stage mode)" \
744	    "0" "$_s10_verify_skips"
745	
746	# ── SPEC-4: --from-stage without --resume refuses with diagnostic ─────────────
747	# [#1805/DSFSTG-4]: --from-stage <s> without explicit --resume exits 1 with the
748	#   diagnostic "--from-stage is only valid with --resume", even when auto-resume
749	#   conditions are present (status=interrupted). The guard fires before auto-resume
750	#   processes state, so no pipeline.resume event is emitted.
751	print_test_section "[#1805/DSFSTG-4] --from-stage without --resume refuses before auto-resume"
752	
753	# Given — a state file exists with status=interrupted (auto-resume conditions met);
754	#   --from-stage is specified on the command line; --resume is NOT given.
755	S11_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
756	S11_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s11-state"
757	S11_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s11-events"
758	S11_EVENTS_JSONL="$S11_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
759	S11_STATE_FILE="$S11_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
760	mkdir -p "$S11_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S11_EVENTS_DIR"
761	
762	# State with status=interrupted so auto-resume would otherwise kick in.
763	jq -n \
764	    --arg run_id "s11-fs4-1805" \
765	    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
766	    --argjson issue "$S11_ID" \
767	    '{
768	        schema_version: 1,
769	        run_id: $run_id,
770	        issue: $issue,
771	        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", cyc: "pending"},
772	        current_iteration: 0,
773	        self_heal_count: {},
774	        scope_manifest_hash: "",
775	        cost_ledger_pointer: 0,
776	        claim_lease_id: "",
777	        plugin_state: {},
778	        status: "interrupted",
779	        updated_at: $now
780	    }' > "$S11_STATE_FILE"
781	
782	# Reuse S3_WORK_REPO (artifact-snapshot-coverage template, which has the cyc
783	# stage). S3_PLUGINS_ROOT is also reused (intake, build, cycled mocks present).
784	
785	# When — the runner is invoked with --from-stage but no --resume.
786	set +e
787	( cd "$S3_WORK_REPO" && env \
788	    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=1 \
789	    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$S3_PLUGINS_ROOT" \
790	    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S11_STATE_DIR" \
791	    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$S11_STATE_FILE" \
792	    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S11_EVENTS_DIR" \
793	    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S11_EVENTS_JSONL" \
794	    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
795	    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
796	    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
797	    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
798	    bash "$RUNNER" --template artifact-snapshot-coverage \
799	        --from-stage cyc --issue "$S11_ID" ) \
800	    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s11-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s11-stderr.txt"
801	_s11_rc=$?
802	set -e
803	
804	# Then — the runner exits 1.
805	# Before change: guard absent → runner auto-resumes (exits 0) or fails for a
806	#   different reason → exit code != 1 → assertion FAILS.
807	# After change: guard fires → runner exits 1 → PASSES.
808	assert_eq "[#1805/DSFSTG-4] --from-stage without --resume exits 1" \
809	    "1" "$_s11_rc"
810	
811	# Then — stderr contains the diagnostic "--from-stage is only valid with --resume".
812	# Before change: guard absent → diagnostic not emitted → FAILS.
813	# After change: guard emits diagnostic → PASSES.
814	_s11_stderr="$(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s11-stderr.txt" 2>/dev/null || true)"
815	assert_contains \
816	    "[#1805/DSFSTG-4] stderr contains --from-stage is only valid with --resume" \
817	    "$_s11_stderr" "--from-stage is only valid with --resume"
818	
819	# Then — no pipeline.resume event is emitted (guard fires before auto-resume processes
820	#   state, so auto-resume never runs).
821	# Before change: auto-resume runs → pipeline.resume emitted → count > 0 → FAILS.
822	# After change: guard fires before auto-resume → no pipeline.resume → PASSES.
823	_s11_resume_events=0
824	if [[ -f "$S11_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
825	    _s11_resume_events="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="pipeline.resume") | .type' \
826	        "$S11_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
827	fi
828	assert_eq "[#1805/DSFSTG-4] no pipeline.resume event emitted (guard fires before auto-resume)" \
829	    "0" "$_s11_resume_events"
830	
831	cleanup_test_env
832	print_test_results

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# tests/unit/status-row-findings-test.sh — a row for a try that did not pass
3	# says what failed (ADR-064 §4, amended 2026-11-06, #2476).
4	#
5	# Why: on #1805 run 42127743259 a failing design try's row read "the design fails
6	# 2 check(s)" and, folded, "The findings are in design's result. This try is
7	# kept as the working copy…"; test-author's read "8 finding(s) about its
8	# assertions are open — the next try fixes them". Nothing said what failed:
9	# since #2470 the findings live in the stage's result only, and the row was
10	# built from the summary only. The row is for the person reading the issue.
11	#
12	# W1 [change] a try that did not pass, whose result holds findings: the row's
13	#             line says how many (#2480: not the first finding, which the folded
14	#             list repeated); the folded part lists every finding once; nothing
15	#             of the summary is shown
16	# W2 [change] a map member (a lens) reads its own result, named on its event,
17	#             and a lens's finding is its message and file
18	# W3 [guard]  a try that did not pass and has no findings shows its summary
19	# W4 [guard]  a try that passed shows its summary, whatever its result holds
20	# W5 [change] #2480: findings with a severity are counted by it
21	# W6 [change] #2480: one finding of several lines: its first line heads the row,
22	#             the rest is folded, and the first line is not said twice
23	# W8 [change] several findings without a severity: the row's line names the
24	#             requirement or SPEC each is about, as the run's rows did not
25	#             ("what failed: 2 findings", #1805 run 42293991602)
26	# W7 [change] #2480: a try run again because its result held findings shows
27	#             as failed, not `unusable` (test-author's own label for "my check
28	#             found something", #2460); one with no findings stays unusable
29	set -uo pipefail
30	
31	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
32	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
33	# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/helpers.sh
34	source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/helpers.sh"
35	# shellcheck source=../../tests/lib/test-helpers.sh
36	source "$REPO_ROOT/tests/lib/test-helpers.sh"
37	print_test_header "a row for a try that did not pass says what failed (#2476)"
38	setup_test_env "status-row-findings"
39	
40	# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/run-status-comment.sh
41	source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/run-status-comment.sh"
42	# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/stage-result.sh
43	source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/stage-result.sh"
44	# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/stage-summary.sh
45	source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/stage-summary.sh"
46	
47	S="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/state"; A="$S/artifacts"; mkdir -p "$A"
48	_row() {   # <seq> <stage> <verdict> [extra-json]
49	    jq -cn --arg q "$1" --arg s "$2" --arg v "$3" --argjson x "${4:-{\}}" \
50	        '{key:$q, seq:$q, stage:$s, kind:"agent", started_ts:"2026-11-06T12:00:00.000Z",
51	          ended_ts:"2026-11-06T12:05:00.000Z", verdict:$v, rc:null} + $x'
52	}
53	
54	# The stage's own writers make its files (#1799): the result with its findings,
55	# the summary with the boilerplate the row must no longer show.
56	stage_result_write "$A/judge-result.json" unusable "the design fails 2 of its checks" \
57	    "{\"findings\": $(printf '%s\n' \
58	        "SKIP-1 Then 1 is not asserted: the test checks the file, not the run" \

63	# ── W1 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
64	w1="$(rsc_render_row "$S" "$(_row 3.1.1.1.1 judge unusable)")"

66	assert_contains "[W1] the folded part lists every finding" "$w1" "BNDY-1 describes what a file contains"
67	assert_eq "[W1] …each once" "1" "$(grep -c "SKIP-1 Then 1 is not asserted" <<< "$w1")"
68	if grep -qF "working copy" <<< "$w1" || grep -qF "fails 2 check(s)" <<< "$w1"; then
69	    assert_fail "[W1] nothing of the summary is shown" "$w1"
70	else
71	    assert_pass "[W1] nothing of the summary is shown"
72	fi
73	
74	# ── W2 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
75	printf '%s\n' '{"lens":"correctness","findings":[{"file":"core/x.sh","line":12,"severity":"high","message":"the loop never ends","introduced":true,"fix":"code"}]}' \

81	assert_contains "[W2] a lens row says what it found, and where" "$w2" "what failed: high: the loop never ends (core/x.sh:12)"

84	stage_result_write "$A/quiet-result.json" timed_out "the model call ran out of time"
85	stage_summary_write "$A/quiet-summary.md" quiet timed_out "ran out of time after reading 40 files"
86	assert_contains "[W3] no findings: the summary as before" \
87	    "$(rsc_render_row "$S" "$(_row 4 quiet timed_out)")" "ran out of time after reading 40 files"

89	# ── W4 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
90	stage_result_write "$A/fine-result.json" pass "ok" '{"findings":[{"n":1,"text":"an advisory note"}]}'
91	stage_summary_write "$A/fine-summary.md" fine pass "wrote tests for LOOP-1 and KEEP-1"
92	w4="$(rsc_render_row "$S" "$(_row 5 fine pass)")"
93	assert_contains "[W4] a pass row shows its summary" "$w4" "wrote tests for LOOP-1 and KEEP-1"
94	if grep -qF "what failed" <<< "$w4"; then assert_fail "[W4] …and never says what failed" "$w4"
95	else assert_pass "[W4] …and never says what failed"; fi

97	# ── W8 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
98	# The words of #1805 run 42293991602's issue-acceptance and test findings.
99	stage_result_write "$A/issue-acceptance-result.json" fail "2 requirements not met" "{\"findings\":$(printf '%s\n' \
100	        'The issue requires this and the change does not meet it: LOOP-1: `_cycle_iter_dispatch` has no code to skip cycle members already marked complete' \
101	        'The issue requires this and the change does not meet it: GUAR-2: The FRSH-2 third assertion added in this DIFF asserts `_frsh2_cycled_starts==1`' | stage_findings_json)}"
102	w8="$(rsc_render_row "$S" "$(_row 3.1.1.1.5 issue-acceptance fail)")"
103	assert_eq "[W8] the line names each requirement not met" "what failed: \`LOOP-1\`, \`GUAR-2\`" "$(sed -n 1p <<< "$w8" | sed 's/.* — //')"
104	stage_result_write "$A/test-result.json" fail "2 files fail" "{\"findings\":$(printf '%s\n' \
105	        'tests/integration/resume-loop-state-test.sh fails: ✗ `` no stage.start for build in iter 2 — expected: 0, got: 1' \
106	        'tests/integration/resume-rehydrate-test.sh fails: ✗ `` fresh run cycle member emits exactly one stage.start — expected: 1, got: 0' | stage_findings_json)}"
107	w8t="$(rsc_render_row "$S" "$(_row 3.1.1.1.4 test fail)")"

109	stage_result_write "$A/note-result.json" fail "2 problems" "{\"findings\":$(printf '%s\n' 'the build left a temp file' 'the build log is empty' | stage_findings_json)}"

117	w8p="$(rsc_render_row "$S" "$(_row 3.1.1.1.5 issue-acceptance fail)")"

119

121	printf '%s\n' '{"lens":"sre","findings":[{"file":"a.sh","severity":"medium","message":"M-ONE"},{"file":"a.sh","severity":"high","message":"H-ONE"},{"file":"a.sh","severity":"medium","message":"M-TWO"}]}' \

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# scripts/lib/run-status-text.sh — what a row of the run-status comment says
3	# (#2131, ADR-064 §4): a stage's findings and its summary's first line, as
4	# text. Sourced by run-status-render.sh; split from it (#2480) to keep each
5	# under 500 lines. Pure: reads files, writes nothing.
6	
7	[[ -n "${_ZBUILD_RUN_STATUS_TEXT_LOADED:-}" ]] && return 0 2>/dev/null
8	_ZBUILD_RUN_STATUS_TEXT_LOADED=1
9	
10	# rsc_row_findings_v <var> <state_dir> <stage> [result_path] — what a try that
11	# did not pass found (ADR-064 §4, #2476, #2480): "what failed: <the finding>",
12	# or the requirements and SPECs several are about ("what failed: `LOOP-1`,
13	# `GUAR-2`"), else "what failed: <n> findings", and what more there is folded
14	# under it; empty
15	# when its result holds none. The
16	# result is the stage's primary output (a map member's is named on its event),
17	# else `artifacts/<stage>-result.json`. A finding is its text, as
18	# stage_findings_json writes it, or a lens's severity, message and file.
19	rsc_row_findings_v() {
20	    local _rfv_p="${4:-}" _rfv_m="" _rfv_raw="" _rfv_l
21	    printf -v "$1" '%s' ""
22	    if [[ -z "$_rfv_p" ]] && declare -F _inputs_stage_manifest_v >/dev/null 2>&1 \
23	            && declare -F _verdict_primary_output_path_v >/dev/null 2>&1; then
24	        _inputs_stage_manifest_v _rfv_m "$3" "${ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT:-$_RSC_ROOT/plugins}" 2>/dev/null || true
25	        [[ -n "$_rfv_m" && -f "$_rfv_m" ]] && _verdict_primary_output_path_v _rfv_raw "$_rfv_m"
26	        [[ -n "$_rfv_raw" ]] && _rfv_p="$(_inputs_output_paths "$3" "$_rfv_raw" "$2" 2>/dev/null || true)"
27	    fi
28	    [[ -n "$_rfv_p" && -s "$_rfv_p" ]] || _rfv_p="$2/artifacts/${3}-result.json"
29	    [[ -s "$_rfv_p" && "$(<"$_rfv_p")" == *'"findings"'* ]] || return 0
30	    # #2480: one finding heads the row, the rest of its lines folded; several
31	    # are named by the id each is about, or counted (by severity when they
32	    # carry one), and each is listed once.
33	    _rfv_l="$(jq -r "$_RSC_JQ_ESC"'[ ((.data.findings // .findings // [])[]? | select(type == "object")
34	            | {sev: (if (.severity | type) == "string" then (.severity | ascii_downcase) else null end),
35	               t: (if (.text | type) == "string" then .text
36	                   elif (.message | type) == "string" then
37	                       (if (.severity | type) == "string" then "\(.severity): " else "" end) + .message
38	                       + (if (.file // "unknown") != "unknown" then " (\(.file)\(if .line then ":\(.line)" else "" end))" else "" end)
39	                   else null end)}
40	            | select(.t != null) | .t |= (gsub("\r"; "") | gsub("\n+$"; "") | esc) | select(.t | test("[^[:space:]]"))) ] as $f
41	        | if ($f | length) == 0 then ""
42	          elif ($f | length) == 1 then
43	            ($f[0].t | split("\n")) as $ls
44	            | "what failed: " + ($ls[0] | gsub("\\|"; "\\|"))
45	              + (if ($ls | length) > 1 then
46	                  "\n<details><summary>what failed</summary>\n\n- " + ($ls[1:] | join("\n  ")) + "\n\n</details>"
47	                else "" end)
48	          else
49	            ([$f[] | .sev | select(. != null)]) as $sv
50	            | (["critical", "high", "medium", "low"]
51	               | map(. as $k | ([$sv[] | select(. == $k)] | length) as $c | select($c > 0) | "\($c) \($k)")) as $cnt
52	            # The requirement or SPEC each is about: the first id on its first
53	            # line. Named when every finding has one and none has a severity.
54	            | [$f[] | .t | split("\n")[0]
55	               | [match("(?<![A-Za-z0-9-])[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{2,5}-[0-9]+(?![0-9])"; "g").string][0]] as $ids
56	            | (if ($sv | length) == 0 and all($ids[]; . != null)
57	               then "what failed: " + ($ids | reduce .[] as $i ([]; if index([$i]) then . else . + [$i] end)
58	                                           | map("`" + . + "`") | join(", "))
59	               else "what failed: \($f | length) findings" + (if ($cnt | length) > 0 then ": " + ($cnt | join(", ")) else "" end) end)
60	              + "\n<details><summary>what failed</summary>\n\n"
61	              + ([$f[] | "- " + (.t | gsub("\n"; "\n  "))] | join("\n")) + "\n\n</details>"
62	          end' "$_rfv_p" 2>/dev/null || true)"
63	    [[ -n "$_rfv_l" ]] || return 0
64	    _rsc_code_labels_v _rfv_l "$_rfv_l"
65	    printf -v "$1" '%s' "$_rfv_l"
66	}
67	
68	# _rsc_first_line_v <var> <summary_file> — the first line with a non-blank
69	# character that is not a heading, `- ` stripped, `|` escaped, whole; the rest
70	# folded under it.
71	_rsc_first_line_v() {
72	    local _rsv_p="$2" _rsv_l=""
73	    printf -v "$1" '%s' ""
74	    [[ -s "$_rsv_p" ]] || return 0
75	    # The first line with a non-blank character that is not a heading, read by
76	    # the shell (it was an awk: `NF && $0 !~ /^#/`).
77	    local _rsv_found=0 _rsv_rest="" _rsv_x
78	    while IFS= read -r _rsv_x || [[ -n "$_rsv_x" ]]; do
79	        if (( _rsv_found )); then
80	            _rsv_rest+="${_rsv_x}"$'\n'
81	        elif [[ "$_rsv_x" =~ [^[:space:]] && "$_rsv_x" != \#* ]]; then
82	            _rsv_found=1; _rsv_l="$_rsv_x"
83	        fi
84	    done < "$_rsv_p"
85	    (( _rsv_found )) || return 0
86	    _rsv_l="${_rsv_l#- }"
87	    _rsc_text_v _rsv_l "$_rsv_l"
88	    _rsv_l="${_rsv_l//|/\\|}"
89	    # The rest, without its leading and trailing blank lines.
90	    while [[ "$_rsv_rest" == $'\n'* ]]; do _rsv_rest="${_rsv_rest#$'\n'}"; done
91	    while [[ "$_rsv_rest" == *$'\n' ]]; do _rsv_rest="${_rsv_rest%$'\n'}"; done
92	    _rsc_text_v _rsv_rest "$_rsv_rest"
93	    [[ "$_rsv_rest" =~ [^[:space:]] ]] \
94	        && _rsv_l+=$'\n'"<details><summary>the rest of what it reported</summary>"$'\n\n'"${_rsv_rest}"$'\n\n'"</details>"
95	    _rsc_code_labels_v _rsv_l "$_rsv_l"
96	    printf -v "$1" '%s' "$_rsv_l"
97	}
98	
99	# _rsc_text_v <var> <text> — what a stage wrote, as text (#2480, ADR-064 §4):
100	# `<` and `>` outside a code span become < and >, so GitHub never takes
101	# `<s>` for a tag; inside one they stay. Read by the shell, appended piece by
102	# piece: a pattern replacement's `&` means the match in bash 5.2.
103	_rsc_text_v() {
104	    local -n _rtv="$1"; local _rt_in="$2" _rt_out="" _rt_seg _rt_code=0
105	    while [[ "$_rt_in" == *'`'* ]]; do
106	        _rt_seg="${_rt_in%%\`*}"; _rt_in="${_rt_in#*\`}"
107	        if (( _rt_code )); then _rt_out+="$_rt_seg"; else _rsc_text_plain "$_rt_seg"; fi
108	        _rt_out+='`'; _rt_code=$(( 1 - _rt_code ))
109	    done
110	    # A backtick with no partner opens no span (review on #2481): what follows
111	    # it is text.
112	    _rsc_text_plain "$_rt_in"
113	    _rtv="$_rt_out"
114	}
115	# _rsc_text_plain <text> — <text> outside a code span, escaped, appended to
116	# _rt_out, the local of its caller _rsc_text_v (bash's dynamic scope).
117	_rsc_text_plain() {
118	    local _rtp="$1"
119	    while [[ "$_rtp" == *[\<\>]* ]]; do
120	        _rt_out+="${_rtp%%[\<\>]*}"; _rtp="${_rtp#"${_rtp%%[\<\>]*}"}"
121	        if [[ "$_rtp" == \<* ]]; then _rt_out+='<'; else _rt_out+='>'; fi
122	        _rtp="${_rtp:1}"
123	    done
124	    _rt_out+="$_rtp"
125	}
126	
127	# _rsc_code_labels_v <var> <text> — each requirement label, `[#1805/FSTG-1]`
128	# (#2462: any SPEC id, descriptive or the old SPEC-3; #2482: with its prefix),
129	# shown as code (#2460): GitHub links `#1805` and shows the issue's title in its
130	# place. One already between backticks is left as it is. Read by the shell.
131	_rsc_code_labels_v() {
132	    local -n _rcl="$1"; local _in="$2" _out="" _pre _lbl
133	    local _re='\[#[0-9]+/[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{2,5}-[0-9]+\]'
134	    while [[ "$_in" =~ $_re ]]; do
135	        _lbl="${BASH_REMATCH[0]}"; _pre="${_in%%"$_lbl"*}"
136	        if [[ "$_pre" == *'`' ]]; then _out+="$_pre$_lbl"; else _out+="$_pre\`$_lbl\`"; fi
137	        _in="${_in#*"$_lbl"}"
138	    done
139	    # Append an empty code span after the last label so the label's closing
140	    # backtick is not misread as opening a new span by some renderers.
141	    if [[ -n "$_out" ]]; then _rcl="$_out${_in}\`\`"; else _rcl="$_in"; fi
142	}
